blockers.title: Active vehicle tied to current policy is projected as incomplete history while detail has canonical plate/policy/vigency.
blockers.invariant: Any vehicle linked to a current policy is current; historical/versioned rows subordinate to the same canonical identity; ambiguous rows remain pending review, never heuristically merged/deleted.

blockers.title: A physical policy version visibly has two concurrent active receipt calendars after payment-plan edit.
blockers.invariant: One physical policy version has exactly one active contractual calendar; superseded rows do not count in current schedule/active portfolio; paid/evidenced receipts are preserved with traceability.

blockers.title: Current policy can render below renewed/historical policies.
blockers.invariant: Order groups: current, renewal-due, renewed/history, cancelled/void; newest vigency first; same-number versions show current first with history subordinate.

blockers.title: Operational UI exposes physical IDs/version/lineage language.
blockers.invariant: Operational UI uses business language; physical IDs and lineage remain only in audit/technical detail when needed.

blockers.title: Section titles/labels remain visually weak while values dominate.
blockers.invariant: Section titles semibold/bold; relevant labels semibold; values regular/medium; total/KPI may stand out; apply cumulatively to Cliente360/Policy/Vehicle/Receipt.

blockers.title: Human logo persistence cannot be verified safely against a real insurer in Preview.
blockers.invariant: Provide visible synthetic insurer fixture for edit/upload/save/refresh/readback/cleanup without relaxing Preview boundary for real insurers.

blockers.title: Sidebar vertical scroll/navigation defect must remain tracked and be fixed now if it blocks module access.
blockers.invariant: Sidebar scroll is visible and usable; if non-blocking in B2 it is mandatory carry-forward to B4.

carryForward.title: An authorized applied/confirmed payment is a confirmed cobro even before reconciliation.
Inferred payment must not inflate the discovery/reconciliation month.
Payment date, reconciliation date, insurer application date, invoice date are separate fields.
Existing reported payments require deterministic classification before projection as confirmed cobros.
Issuance expenses/surcharges need insurer + product/line + payment-frequency configuration with policy override.
Dashboard must reconcile real portfolio, confirmed cobros, pending payments, reconciliation, currency/country and aging.
Renewal flow has competing legacy and operational owners and must be consolidated into one canonical end-to-end owner.
Portal/importer/email surfaces must converge on the canonical financial and management model.
